evidence.quote: Request a separate fee proportionate to the fund, with any reduction benefiting the class rather than reverting to Brightline.
Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the first round, not only after class relief was agreed.
We can reduce our fee request to $6 million, subject to court approval, if Brightline increases the class fund to $34 million.

summary: Plaintiff raised fees first, and fees were negotiated alongside class relief before the final class fund was settled. There is explicit linkage because class counsel offered to reduce its fee request if the defense increased the class fund. The transcript does not show class counsel prioritizing its own fee over the class, defense leveraging fee interest, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
